name: waiting-on-me
description: Files a Claude Code desktop session under a sidebar section while it ends on a question or an action for you, and moves it back once a turn ends with nothing pending.

section.title: Section name
section.description: Sidebar section that holds the sessions waiting on you.

useJev.title: Use Jev
useJev.description: When Claude gives no wrap_up signal, classify the final message with the jev CLI if it is installed.

jevThreshold.title: Jev threshold
jevThreshold.description: Probability of waiting (0 to 1) at or above which the session counts as waiting.
